experiment: Home Commerce Director Experimental Validation v2 — School Memory Book

sample.product_identity: Spiral-bound School Memories Album with grade-specific prompts and photo/drawing spaces

novelty.note: The category and footage were not used in the four prior internal cases or the Knowledge Mining worked examples.

media_inventory.audio: AAC stereo 48 kHz present in every source; no spoken-content claim was used in this judgment

files.content: Clean front-cover presentation; cover text identifies a School Memories Album and says it is a place for a child's keepsakes.
Long cover-to-interior walkthrough. Visible sections include Preschool, Kindergarten, 1st Grade, 5th Grade, 9th Grade and 11th Grade, plus photo, drawing and written-prompt areas.
Preschool close-up; finger indicates name, age, height/weight, teacher and school-activity checklist fields.
Close-up of friends and favorites prompts, including names, lunch food, story, school game and TV show fields.
1st Grade close-up with a school-picture box, self-drawing box and basic profile lines.
Grade progression demonstration: 1st Grade followed by visible 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th Grade spreads.
4th Grade detail close-up showing school-picture, height/weight, teacher, favorite book/author, subjects, clubs/sports and signature fields.
Later-grade detail pages with favorites, memorable-event and self-reflection prompts; a 7th Grade heading is visible.
9th Grade spread showing photo space and prompts for signature, height/weight, class, teacher and high-school reflections.
Hand-held product Hero and thickness/page-volume views; repeated rotations of the cover and page block.
Edge flip-through that reveals many differently designed sections, then a clean album placement/cover state.

provable_facts.fact: The product identifies itself on the cover as a School Memories Album and as a place for a child's keepsakes.

The album contains visibly separated school-year sections extending from Preschool/Kindergarten into later grades; Preschool, Kindergarten, 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th and 11th Grade headings are directly visible in the reviewed material.
Pages provide blank spaces for a school picture and, on some pages, a self-drawing.
Pages contain writable prompts for details such as name/signature, height, weight, teacher, friends, favorites, subjects, activities and reflections.
The physical album is spiral-bound and contains many visibly distinct printed page designs.
The source set shows hands turning, pointing to and presenting the album, but no child or family interaction.

forbidden_claims: Any claim that a real child enjoyed, loved or reacted emotionally to the album.
Any claim that the album improves family relationships or causes conversations.
Any fabricated home, gifting, classroom or family-use scene.
Any claim that completed memories, photos or handwriting are present; reviewed pages are blank.
Any exact grade coverage, page count or capacity beyond directly visible headings/pages.
Archival, acid-free, waterproof, fireproof, durable, premium-paper or preservation-performance claims.
Price, discount, scarcity, shipping, rating, bestseller or availability claims.
Directional purchase CTA such as click below, tap the link or buy here; no UI or direction evidence exists.
material_gaps: No child, parent or family interaction/reaction.
No filled-in page, inserted photograph or time-lapse showing accumulated use.
No before/after comparison against loose school records.
No verified contents page, exact grade range, total page count or material specification.
No gift handoff, shelf-storage or revisit scene.
No price, offer, purchase interface or directional CTA gesture.
No clean simultaneous view of an early-grade and late-grade spread; an editor would need a montage from separate supported states.

eligibility.complete_candidate_proof: Claim: the album organizes school-year information across multiple years; owner: the album; action: turn between grade sections; result: distinct grade headings and structured prompts appear; confirmation: early- and later-grade spreads remain readable.
eligibility.first_purchase_meaning_candidate: A supported contrast between an early-grade section and a later-grade section can communicate one structured album for multiple school years.
eligibility.review_scope_note: Visual review used extracted diagnostic frames only; no final media was rendered or uploaded.
